tasks.title: Configurable worker command template in go port
tasks.accept: cd go && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Extend the Go port (go/) so the worker command is configurable. Read go/config.go and go/execute.go first, plus the e2e in go/e2e/ to mirror its fixture style. Requirement: workers.json entries accept an optional string field `command`. When present, dispatch = substitute the placeholder {prompt} with the ABSOLUTE path of the rendered prompt file, then run the resulting string via the platform shell in the task worktree (go/execute.go already has the platform-shell helper: cmd /C on Windows, sh -c otherwise). When absent, behavior must be EXACTLY as today (pi-shaped: cli --provider

--model -p @) — do not regress the existing e2e cases. Config parsing: add `Command string `json:"command"`` to the worker struct; no validation beyond non-empty-when-present. Prove with a new e2e case in go/e2e/e2e_test.go (mirror the existing fake-agent fixture): a campaign whose worker has `command` set to invoke the fake agent script directly with {prompt} as its argument (no shell builtins needed, cross-platform), asserting: the fake agent received the real prompt file path, the campaign completed (state Done), gate ran in the worktree, and the result merged — same assertions as the existing success case. Also one assertion that the default (no command) dispatch still builds the pi-shaped command line (unit-test the command builder if one exists, else assert via the fake agent capturing argv). Stdlib only, gofmt-clean, go vet clean. Commit on the current branch.
